parties: Arun Kumar Saraf (acquirer); Asian Hotels (East) Limited
headline: Arun Kumar Saraf files SEBI Regulation 10(5) disclosure for Asian Hotels (East) Limited
sum: Arun Kumar Saraf filed a substantial acquisition of shares disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations (Regulation 10(5)) with NSE for Asian Hotels (East) Limited, signalling either a threshold breach or triggering event requiring mandatory disclosure of shareholding and intent.
implication: Regulation 10(5) filings mark the beginning of the mandatory takeover disclosure window under SEBI - a director or substantial shareholder's trigger of public notice mechanics, requiring contemporaneous review of exemptions (creeping acquisition, pledge release) and acquisition pathway (open offer, negotiated deal, or open market).
detail: The disclosure was filed by Arun Kumar Saraf in his capacity as an individual acquirer. Under SEBI Takeover Regulations 2011, Regulation 10(5) mandates disclosure when a person acquires 25% or more shares, or crosses into or within the 25%–75% band, or any person having management control. The filing to NSE establishes the formal regulatory trigger point; subsequent disclosures must follow on a staged timeline. No public offer details, valuation or transaction structure are evident from this filing alone.

framework.ref: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, Reg. 10(5)
framework.note: Mandates disclosure to stock exchange and SEBI within 2 working days of acquisition or of becoming aware of acquisition crossing 25% threshold or within 25%–75% band.
Open offer obligation triggered if 25% or more shares acquired; exemptions (creeping, pledged securities, intra-group transfers) require substantiation.
Defines 'person', 'group', 'acquirer', and key thresholds triggering disclosure and mandatory offer obligations.

framework.ref: Securities and Exchange Board of India Act, 1992, § 15(1A)
framework.note: Grants SEBI power to make regulations for takeovers; substantive oversight and enforcement authority.

framework.ref: SEBI Takeover Regulations 2011, Reg. 3 & Sched. I
framework.note: Form of disclosure, timing requirements and schedule of public announcements.
Exchange-specific obligations for listed companies to furnish acquisition notices and regulatory compliance proofs.
Director/promoter shareholding disclosures complement SEBI filings; cross-check for consistency.
KYC/beneficial ownership verification required for all acquirers at SEBI and exchange filing stage.

conditions: Disclosure triggering event: presumed 25% threshold acquisition or band-crossing
Mandatory public announcement and SEBI notification within prescribed timeline
Open offer (if 25%+ acquired and not exempt) required within 60 days
approvals: SEBI review and approval (if open offer triggered)
Competition Commission of India (CCI) approval if deal value triggers merger review (>₹3,000 cr revenue test)
structure.novel: Regulation 10(5) filing itself is procedural; no novel structure evident from disclosure form alone.

triggers.law: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, Reg. 10(5)
triggers.note: Acquisition or awareness of crossing 25% or entering/within 25%–75% band requires disclosure within 2 working days to stock exchange and SEBI.
If 25% or more shares acquired (and no exemption), mandatory public offer to remaining shareholders at price determined by SEBI valuation guidelines.
